messages:
maggie: Heads up — ACME asked for a bundled onramp: marketplace private offer + hardware credit + SI integration. They want aggressive first-year pricing and a clear renewal path. Need quick ops + pricing plan by EOD.

samir: Any precedent numbers? last time with OrionCloud we did a 30% blended off-list on a 12m commit, but that leaned heavily on HW kickers.

ana: @samir (FYI spelling) — do you mean 30% total or 30% on software SKU? we usually split.

samir: 30% blended total. For this ask, propose splitting: 25% discount on usage (tokens/embeddings) + 15% off dedicated/reserved. Leaves margin for HW credit.

ana: I like the split. Also recommend SI uplift: 10% rebate for partner services first 6 months to accelerate deploy.

liam: Product note — we must map model SKUs to marketplace SKUs and ensure the private-offer SKU supports reserved throughput toggles. Marketing wants co-announce timeline (they asked for 2 weeks pre-announce).

legal-bot: Flag: any auto-renewal or extended credit visibility must use template PO-23. Do not promise multi-year credits without signed revenue guarantee. Also include standard export control clause.

maggie: Ops ask: samir, can you produce SKU mapping + brief runbook? Example CSV format below for ops/marketplace team to ingest:

```
marketplace_sku,internal_model_sku,offer_type,discount_percent,notes
RWD-EMBED-XL,emb-xl-v2,private_offer,25,usage discount first 12 months
RWD-DED-GPUA,ded-gpu-a1,private_offer,15,dedicated reserved bucket
RWD-HW-CREDIT,hw-credit-2026,kicker,NA,one-time HW credit applied at invoice
```

samir: putting that in a draft now. ops will need the CPID and seller id to create the private offer.

ana: I'll draft the SI comms and propose a one-pager for the partner (scope, milestones, uplift). Can we confirm the renewal language? propose: 12m initial, optional 12m renewal at min 80% of committed baseline if usage targets met.

liam: Product wants a safety rollback: canary 5% traffic + feature flag `acme_bundle_v1`. Fallback to hosted model pool if latency > 200ms for 2 consecutive mins.

deploy-bot: CI build kicked by samir at 1708004333 for marketplace-offer-import. Tests: 47 passed, 2 flaky (retries ok).

maggie: OK next steps: maggie -> draft PO terms (incl PO-23), samir -> SKU mapping + ops runbook + CPID request, ana -> SI comms + partner one-pager, liam -> add feature flag + rollback plan, legal -> insert PO-23 template. Marketing sync separately for co-announce 2-week prep.

ana: timeline acked. I'll have SI one-pager by EOD and schedule partner call.

samir: SKU CSV + initial CPID ticket created (ops case #34567). ETA morning.

liam: I’ll add the flag and the canary playbook to the repo in a PR this afternoon.

maggie: :thumbsup: thanks team. If anyone hits blockers ping here with short status.

ana: ping — @maggie got a quick q: do we price HW credit as dollar-off invoice or a line-item? prefer line-item to make renewal math cleaner.

maggie: line-item preferred. makes revenue recognition easier.

legal-bot: Reminder: any line-item that looks like a discount must be labeled as a credit in contract to avoid GAAP misclassification. Use label `Partner Hardware Credit` in invoices.

maggie: noted. wrapping up — will post a clean summary in the channel once PO draft is ready.
